request.title: [Review] C10 part A (1/2): independent review of the weighted-inverse, linear-data, kinetic-response and determinant chapters
request.body:
## Bounded independent review

Parent package: C10 (#51, closed), unit YM-000026, umbrella #26. Coordinator: @hairer. Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base branch: `codex/existence-monograph` (`ddc3c90`).

The C10 author pass (PR #95, session `schmittj-claude-c10-20261112`) changed sixteen chapters. Its README says: "Status: author draft, not reviewed … An independent reviewer owns `review/`." The only independent review so far (PR #99, `mgubi-codex-c10-annulus-20261113`) covers the four annulus chapters. The eight part-A chapters have had no independent review. #51 was closed with that review outstanding.

This task reviews five of the part-A chapters, the linear-algebra and determinant group:

| Chapter | SHA-256 at `ddc3c90` |
| --- | --- |
| `manuscript/existence/weighted-frame-penalty.tex` | `d48a52846c0a62a147740bf1501e7a3a91311d9a3dfa8b86f6688d303e361f64` |
| `manuscript/existence/weighted-stationary-inverses.tex` | `46f3a95065dab9f280ca520f2cbbd58aed43a5f904cbed2ee308590fa90a1880` |
| `manuscript/existence/selected-stationary-linear-data.tex` | `d5f20e2f39502b821ca6cd965345eb6fd61cfe8ba9974996ef5f49b3f8151f52` |
| `manuscript/existence/selected-kinetic-response.tex` | `3ead2deac5a25404b78491a3688d008061558c72335e7abfe86a9d515f6ec212` |
| `manuscript/existence/stationary-determinant-prices.tex` | `c330251aa54264c2908974b961b8b04aaaee5b8e7760119c46818bc72d8fa396` |

These hashes equal the author handoff hashes in `results/C10/README.md`, so the reviewed text is the author pass.

Out of scope, left for separate review tasks: `soft-curvature-receipts.tex`, `multileg-curvature-lift.tex`, `thermal-contact-cancellation.tex` (rest of part A), and the five non-annulus part-B chapters (`classical-stationary-vertices`, `stationary-germ-symmetry`, `stationary-output-construction`, `inherited-loop-transport`, `quadratic-pole-transport`), plus renewed review of the C10 revision 1 and 2 hunks (`annulus-same-data-binding.tex`, `annulus-two-wave-estimates.tex`).

## Review questions

Both roles of `docs/proof-standard.md`:
- Mathematics: does each statement follow from its stated hypotheses and named inputs, at monograph detail? Check in particular the positivity hypothesis added to `weighted-stationary-inverses.tex`, the corrected complex-strip bound (≤5h) in `stationary-determinant-prices.tex`, and that the tangent identity in `selected-stationary-linear-data.tex` is an explicitly named input from C11 rather than a hidden gap. Are standard results (Neumann series, Schur complements, determinant/trace bounds, Cauchy estimates) cited precisely and applicable?
- Lean correspondence: do the statements, quantifiers and hypotheses match the declarations named in `results/C10/part-A/correspondence.md` at the pin, after inspecting the meaning-determining definitions?
- Records: are `part-A/ledger.md`, `findings.md` and `correspondence.md` accurate for these chapters?

## Owned outputs

`blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C10/review/<session>/` only (report-only). No chapter, author record, shared include, preamble, glossary, bibliography or Lean edits; proposed fixes go in the report.

## Readiness and acceptance

Ready: the author claims on #51 (pass, rev1, rev2) are released; the five chapters are unchanged since the author handoff; no live review claim names them. Reviewer must not have authored any C10 file. Post and recheck a claim here before work.

Acceptance: exact fingerprints inspected; findings separated into required changes and suggestions, each with a location and evidence; commands actually run; blueprint checker and tests; a build of the chapters with the reviewed pages inspected; one focused report-only draft PR against `codex/existence-monograph`; handoff here and a pointer on #26. A human takes responsibility for acceptance; the review does not approve anything.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
